title: A cold woven build takes 6.9x-39x longer than a plain go build (threshold 5x)
claim: Cold GOCACHE woven build: bootstrap 167.8s/283 CPU-s vs 4.3s/3.7 CPU-s plain (39x wall). Overhead test 78.7s vs 11.4s (6.9x). Most of it is the Orchestrion self-build (~112 CPU-s) and the tracer (the control is already 10.3x/7.9x). The dd-iast-go increment is 3.8x wall/1.8x CPU on bootstrap and within noise on overhead. Warm rebuilds take 6.7-13.8s. Peak RSS <=1.09 GB.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOCACHE=$(mktemp -d) GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 /usr/bin/time -l go tool orchestrion go build -work -o bootstrap ./cmd/bootstrap

title: A woven small binary is 12.7x (+20.4 MB) larger than plain; dd-iast-go's own share is 1-5%
claim: The empty-main bootstrap grows 1,749,218 -> 22,194,578 bytes. The tracer-only control is 21,098,994, so dd-iast-go adds 1,095,584 bytes (1.05x). Realistic binaries: overhead 1.11x vs plain, 1.02x vs control; testapp test 1.01x.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOCACHE=$(mktemp -d) GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go build -o woven ./cmd/bootstrap && GOCACHE=$(mktemp -d) GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go build -o plain ./cmd/bootstrap && ls -l woven plain

title: 63 stdlib IAST weave sites are compiled into every woven binary, regardless of use
claim: Identical across targets: bytes 36, net/http 14, encoding/json 7, io 4, bufio 1, net/url 1. App-root sites scale with app code (13 testapp, 7 benchmark).
repro_command: go tool orchestrion go build -work ./cmd/bootstrap; grep -rhoE '__orchestrion_[A-Za-z0-9_]*iast[A-Za-z0-9_]*\.[A-Za-z]+\(' $WORK/*/orchestrion/src | sort | uniq -c
